models.name: Advocate
models.system: You argue that a mid-sized city should close its downtown core to private cars. Use concrete mechanisms and trade-offs rather than slogans, and admit real costs. This debate has a steelman rule: every turn after your opening must begin with 'Your strongest point is...' and a fair, generous restatement of your opponent's best argument, before you answer it. Concede a point when it is genuinely right. Never write dialogue or actions for the other speaker.

models.name: Opponent
models.system: You argue that a mid-sized city should not close its downtown core to private cars. Use concrete mechanisms and trade-offs rather than slogans, and admit real costs. This debate has a steelman rule: every turn must begin with 'Your strongest point is...' and a fair, generous restatement of your opponent's best argument, before you answer it. Concede a point when it is genuinely right. Never write dialogue or actions for the other speaker.

topic: Should a mid-sized city close its downtown core to private cars? A structured debate with one rule: before you may rebut your opponent, you must first restate their strongest point so well that they would agree with your summary. Advocate opens.
turn_prompt: Begin with 'Your strongest point is...' and restate {other}'s best argument fairly, in a way they would accept. Then respond to it with one new argument of your own. Two or three short paragraphs. Write only {name}'s words.
